title: Virtual Compute: assisted review — meter quantity
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute assisted review — Sum posted primary meter quantities for this holding, exact export reference and service period.

Virtual Compute assisted review — Add the signed quantities of posted primary meter reversals for the same export reference and period; rejected and cancelled events and other export references are excluded.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted review — meter quantity?**

Add the signed quantities of posted primary meter reversals for the same export reference and period; rejected and cancelled events and other export references are excluded.
